Technical Reference for fit_mfrm() Specifications, Controls, and Estimators

Source: R/help_fit_mfrm_technical_details.R
fit_mfrm_technical_details.Rd

Offline specification dictionary for fit_mfrm(): spec and control keys, model equations, scale identification, estimator scopes, information criteria, and return-object provenance. Use fit_mfrm() for the signature and first analysis, mfrmr_api_migration_030 for call migration, and mfrmr_methods_reference for primary methodological literature.

Every specification key below can be passed in spec = list(...) (shared across describe_mfrm_data(), review_mfrm_anchors(), fit_mfrm(), and export_mfrm_model() within each function's supported scope) or as a named argument to fit_mfrm(); every control key below can be passed in control = list(...) or as a named argument in .... Only data, person, facets, and score retain positional order. Input data must be in long format (one row per observed rating event).

Specification entries (spec = list(...))

person

Character scalar naming the Person identifier column.

facets

Character vector of non-Person facet column names. Reserved names (Person, Score, Weight, score_k, theta, steps, interactions, log_slopes, beta, log_sigma2) are rejected as facet names; rename colliding facet columns before analysis.

score

Ordered integer category column (including binary 0/1 or 1/2). Shared preparation rounds values within 1e-6 of an integer (fit$prep$preparation_notes) and rejects other fractions; corrected JML and two-family GPCM require exact integers. Empty boundary categories can imply a nonfinite MLE (BoundaryState = "nonfinite_maximum"); an unused preserved internal category stops ordinary fitting with a structured category-support error.

weight

Optional positive observation-weight column powering each row's conditional likelihood contribution. Non-positive weights are dropped; non-unit weights exclude ordinary formal inference, facet equivalence, and the common MML IC panel.

rating_min, rating_max

Optional intended rubric bounds, supplied together when boundary categories may be unobserved.

category_policy

"collapse" (default when keep_original = FALSE) maps observed gaps to consecutive categories; "preserve" retains the declared rating_min:rating_max ladder (fit$prep$score_map).

keep_original

Compatibility alias for category policy (FALSE = "collapse", TRUE = "preserve"); must agree if both are supplied.

missing_codes

Optional sentinel recoding to NA before preparation: NULL (none), TRUE/"default" (standard sentinel set on score only), or an explicit character vector across person, facet, and score columns (fit$prep$missing_recoding).

repeated_ratings

"review" (default) warns on duplicate Person-by-facet cells and records an input-review state; "independent" records an analyst declaration of conditionally independent rating events without aggregating rows or altering the likelihood (unsupported in two-family GPCM).

model

"RSM" (default), "PCM", or "GPCM".

method

"MML" (default), "JML" (alias "JMLE"), or "CML" (native RSM/PCM with preserved categories and unit weights).

step_facet

Single facet owning category-step vectors in PCM and GPCM (explicitly required for GPCM and CML; unused in RSM).

slope_facet

Facet(s) owning positive discriminations in GPCM. One-family MML allows slope_facet != step_facet; JML requires equality; an ordered length-2 vector selects two-family GPCM MML.

gpcm_mml_identification

Scale identification for one-family GPCM MML: "free_population" (default) estimates \(N(\beta_0,\sigma^2)\) when population_formula = NULL with geometric-mean-one relative slopes (absolute standardized slopes \(\sigma\alpha_g\)); "fixed_standard_normal" fixes \(N(0,1)\) alongside geometric-mean-one slopes (or reference-family geometric mean 1 in two-family GPCM).

anchors

Optional direct location-anchor table (Facet, Level, Anchor) in internal logit coordinates. Person anchors require JML.

group_anchors

Optional unweighted group-mean constraint table (Facet, Level, Group, GroupValue repeated across group members). Person group constraints require JML.

anchor_policy

Issue handling in anchor review: "warn" (default in fitting), "error" (default in model export), or "silent". Contradictory constraints always stop.

min_common_anchors, min_obs_per_element, min_obs_per_category

Local count thresholds used by anchor-review recommendations (5, 10, 10 by default); counts do not establish cross-run invariance.

slope_reference

For two-family GPCM MML, names which member of slope_facet is constrained to geometric mean 1 (NULL selects the first supplied slope facet).

noncenter_facet

Single facet left uncentered (default "Person").

centering_scope

"facet" (default) centers across all levels including anchors/groups; "remainder" centers unconstrained levels only; "anchor_origin" (ordinary additive RSM/PCM JML) replaces centering on anchored facets when an active unanchored noncenter_facet is chosen.

positive_facets

Character vector of facets oriented +1 (higher location = higher expected coded score); others use -1.

dummy_facets

Character vector of facets fixed at 0.

facet_interactions

Optional confirmatory two-way non-Person interaction terms (e.g., "Rater:Criterion") in RSM/PCM, identified by zero row and column marginal sums.

min_obs_per_interaction, interaction_policy

Minimum weighted cell count (10) and sparse-cell policy ("warn", "error", or "silent") for facet_interactions.

population_formula

Optional one-sided latent-regression formula (e.g., ~ grade + ses or ~ 1) for unidimensional conditional-normal method = "MML" (\(\theta \mid x \sim N(x^\top\beta,\sigma^2)\)).

person_data, person_id

One-row-per-Person covariate data.frame (expanded via stats::model.matrix(), storing xlevels and contrasts) and its Person ID column (defaults to person).

population_policy

Missing-covariate policy for latent regression: "error" (default) or "omit" (records omitted Persons/rows in fit$population).

population_sd

Optional positive fixed residual SD for direct additive RSM/PCM MML with an explicit population_formula.

Estimation and numerical control entries (control = list(...))

quad_points

Gauss-Hermite quadrature order for MML (default 31; automatic IC selection requires >= 31; check sensitivity with mml_quadrature_sensitivity()).

mml_engine

"direct" (default marginal-likelihood optimizer), "em" (fixed-grid RSM/PCM without covariates and two-family GPCM), or "hybrid" (EM warm-start followed by direct optimization).

mml_integration

"fixed" (default), "adaptive" (moving posterior-mode Gauss-Hermite nodes in direct MML without checkpoints), or "auto" (checks Person log-marginal, EAP, SD, and gradient tolerances against refined rules; raises mfrmr_mml_accuracy_error on failure, recording last_candidate under provenance_version = 2).

mml_accuracy_control

Named list for mml_integration = "auto": ordinary MML defaults adaptive_points = c(31, 61, 121) (checked against 2*q + 1), loglik_tol = 1e-7, posterior_tol = 1e-6, gradient_tol = 1e-4, or max_points; two-family defaults max_points = 241 (2*q - 1 reference).

mml_starts

Optional deterministic offset vector or named list of free-coordinate starting vectors for ordinary RSM/PCM or one-family GPCM MML (fit$opt$start_review).

gpcm_mml_start

Starting-value policy for two-family adaptive direct MML: NULL/"neutral_em" (compares neutral and fixed-grid EM seed under the adaptive objective), "neutral", or a named list of >= 2 native free-parameter vectors (fit$opt$mml_initialization).

em_score_tol

Per-Person marginal score stopping tolerance for two-family GPCM MML-EM (1e-6 when NULL; NULL required elsewhere).

checkpoint

Optional list(file = ..., every_iter = ...) for resumable identity-checked MML EM runs.

maxit

Iteration ceiling per optimization stage (default 400), not a convergence guarantee.

reltol

Optimizer tolerance (default 1e-9). With reltol <= 1e-9, code-zero terminal-gradient shortfalls trigger bounded non-worsening polishing (fit$opt$optimizer_polish), including up to three sparse exact-information Newton steps in additive RSM/PCM JML (jml_information_polish) and curvature restarts (<= 64 free parameters) in supported MML routes.

optimizer

"auto" (default: L-BFGS-B for MML and JML with >= 200 free parameters, BFGS otherwise), "BFGS", or "L-BFGS-B" (see OptimizerFactr and OptimizerPgtol in fit$summary).

progress

Logical (FALSE default) enabling cli elapsed-time display without changing numerical controls.

jml_penalty

"none" (default) or "jeffreys" for additive RSM/PCM JML, returning mfrm_jeffreys_fit.

jml_correction_order

NULL (default) or positive integer k selecting experimental profile-score bias adjustment for shared-owner GPCM JML (nleqslv required).

jml_correction_sampling

Sandwich Person-covariance centering for corrected JML: "fixed_rosters" (default; >= 2 Persons per pattern) or "random_rosters".

facet_shrinkage, facet_prior_sd, shrink_person

Post-fit descriptive Empirical Bayes adjustment ("none" default, "empirical_bayes", or alias "laplace"), optional fixed prior SD, and ordinary-JML Person flag (FALSE default; see apply_empirical_bayes_shrinkage()).

attach_diagnostics

Logical (FALSE default); if TRUE, runs diagnose_mfrm(fit, residual_pca = "none") once and attaches measure/step diagnostic columns.

fit_scope, comparison_review

"full" (default) or "comparisons" with a matching describe_mfrm_data() comparison_review returning mfrm_comparison_fit.

Model and Logistic metric (D = 1)

All native models use the logistic metric with \(D = 1\) (no 1.7/1.702 multiplier). For additive RSM/PCM with Person \(n\), rater \(j\), and criterion \(i\): $$\ln\frac{P(X_{nij} = k)}{P(X_{nij} = k-1)} = \theta_n - \delta_j - \beta_i - \tau_k$$ (RSM shares \(\tau_k\); PCM estimates \(\tau_{i,k}\) per step_facet level; binary K = 1 reduces to \(\eta - \tau_1\)). Confirmatory facet_interactions add \(+\gamma_{ji}\) with \(\sum_j\gamma_{ji} = 0\) and \(\sum_i\gamma_{ji} = 0\). One-family GPCM scales the complete adjacent-category predictor: $$\ln\frac{P(X_{nij} = k)}{P(X_{nij} = k-1)} = \alpha_g(\eta - \tau_{h,k}),\quad \alpha_g > 0,\quad \prod_{g=1}^G \alpha_g^{1/G} = 1.$$ Because \(\alpha_g\) multiplies \(\theta_n\), all facet locations, and \(\tau_{h,k}\), it differs from loading-only formulations where slopes multiply \(\theta_n\) alone.

Uncorrected JML jointly maximizes fixed Person and structural parameters without finite bounds or the dichotomous \((L-1)/L\) heuristic, subject to Neyman-Scott incidental-parameter bias at fixed ratings per Person (Haberman, 2004). Exploratory JML location SEs use observation-table information \(\mathrm{SE}_g \approx [\sum_{r \in g} w_r a_r^2 \mathrm{Var}(X_r \mid \widehat\eta_r)]^{-1/2}\) (Fixed = TRUE rows keep NA SEs). Extreme free JML Persons return -Inf/Inf in Estimate (with computational trace in OptimizerEstimate); MML integrates Persons over the declared normal prior and reports post-hoc EAPs and posterior SDs.

Two slope families

Setting model = "GPCM", method = "MML", slope_facet = c(F1, F2), gpcm_mml_identification = "fixed_standard_normal", and explicit step_facet and noncenter_facet fits the multiplicative Uto and Ueno (2020) predictor \(\alpha_{1,g}\alpha_{2,m}(\eta - \tau_{h,k})\) on one fixed \(N(0,1)\) ability dimension using unweighted zero-based integer scores (0:rating_max), with either fixed-grid "em" or adaptive "direct" MML. slope_reference fixes one slope family's geometric mean to 1 while the second family is free. Experimental component-slope, step, and location intervals (confint.mfrm_fit(), mfrm_facet_intervals()), fixed-calibration posterior residuals (mfrm_response_diagnostics()), and conditional scoring (predict_mfrm_units()) retain separate numerical checks; Wright maps, ordinary fit diagnostics, and IC ranking remain unavailable (see mfrmr_gpcm_scope).

Corrected JML

Positive integer jml_correction_order = k solves the adjusted profile-score equation \(U_k = (I - K_\beta)^k U_0 = 0\) (Dhaene & Weidner, 2023, Section 8.1) for additive shared-owner GPCM JML with preserved integer categories (<= 5,000 joint owner-total states per assignment pattern; no anchors, weights, interactions, or shrinkage). Empirical Person-contribution Jacobians yield RootSE and LogRootSE under "fixed_rosters" or "random_rosters"; these describe local root variation rather than coverage-qualified structural confidence intervals.

Jeffreys-penalized JML

Setting method = "JML", jml_penalty = "jeffreys" on identified unit-weight additive RSM/PCM with preserved rating_min:rating_max minimizes \(-\ell(\beta) - \tfrac12\log|I(\beta)|\) in affine free canonical coordinates (Firth, 1993; Kosmidis & Firth, 2021), returning mfrm_jeffreys_fit (summary.mfrm_jeffreys_fit()) with point estimates and numerical checks (checks$polish), connecting to common-plan expected-score intervals in confint.mfrm_fair_average() without Wald parameter SEs or ICs.

Conditional maximum likelihood

Setting method = "CML", category_policy = "preserve" on unit-weight additive or two-way-interaction RSM/PCM conditions on Person totals \(s_p = \sum_j y_{pj}\): $$\ell_c(\beta) = \sum_{p,j} x_{pj,y_{pj}}^\top\beta - \sum_p \log [t^{s_p}] \prod_j \sum_{k=0}^K \exp(x_{pjk}^\top\beta)t^k,$$ evaluated via log-scale generalized ESF recursions with dynamic-programming LP recession checks (lpSolve). Full-scope CML returns mfrm_cml_fit with unregularized inverse conditional-information covariance (NA matrix with checks$information_status = "unavailable" if singular) and connects to mfrm_facet_intervals() without Person or population parameters (Mair & Hatzinger, 2007).

Comparison-only estimation

Setting fit_scope = "comparisons" with a prospective comparison_review returns mfrm_comparison_fit for identifiable facet-by-origin contrasts in rank-deficient designs (nrow(A)*ncol(A) <= 2e6, ncol(A)^2 <= 2e6). JML and MML project onto the column-scaled SVD range and report descriptive_only contrast points (FormalInferenceEligible = FALSE). CML optimizes in the conditional support-difference subspace \(\beta = T\gamma + v\) (\(Cv = 0\)) with basis-invariant covariance \(CT(T^\top I_N T)^{-1}T^\top C^\top\) (EstimateStatus = "conditional_wald" or "conditional_point"), distinguishing estimability (Lenth, 2015) from exponential-family recession cones (Geyer, 2009, doi:10.1214/08-EJS349 ).

Latent-regression workflow

With method = "MML", population_formula, and one-row-per-Person person_data, Person quadrature nodes follow \(\theta_{nq} = x_n^\top\beta + \sigma z_q\). summary(fit)$population_coefficients and $population_overview report point estimates without automatic SEs; request experimental joint-information intervals via mfrm_population_intervals() (RSM/PCM). In anchored RSM/PCM cohorts, noncenter_facet = "Rater" with a direct Rater anchor and population_formula = ~ 1 (optionally fixed population_sd) estimates the receiving-cohort mean without forcing new raters to sum to zero.

Pre-fit estimability and Information-criterion contract

Before optimization, sparse adjacent-logit rank checks stop exact rank deficiency with mfrmr_estimability_error and warn (mfrmr_estimability_warning) when MML cross-panel contrasts rely solely on a shared population (fit$data_review$estimability, including normal_population_identification and nonlinear_local_estimability).

For eligible unit-weight MML fits with D = -2 * LogLik, free dimension k = Npar, and unique prepared Persons N_person (ICSampleSize), the canonical panel is AIC = D + 2*k, BIC = D + log(N_person)*k, and SABIC = D + log((N_person + 2)/24)*k (SABICSelectable = FALSE when N_person <= 22). Ineligible fits set canonical AIC/BIC/SABIC to NA (LegacyAIC/LegacyBIC retained separately). ICIntegrationTier classifies quad_points (< 15 "coarse_screening", 15:30 "intermediate_review", 31:60 "standard_start", >= 61 "dense_sensitivity"), with ICSelectable = FALSE below 31 points in compare_mfrm().

Detailed return-object provenance

Depending on estimator and scope, fit_mfrm() returns mfrm_jeffreys_fit, mfrm_cml_fit, mfrm_comparison_fit, or a named mfrm_fit list with: summary (fit metrics, IC contract, convergence, optimizer controls), facets$person (Estimate, MML SD, Extreme, SourceFitReadiness, EstimateUse), facets$others, steps, slopes (OptimizerEstimate, PrimaryEstimate, ParameterStatus, SEEligible, CIEligible, ReasonCodes, plus point_limit and config$boundary_audit records), readiness, interactions, population (person_table, person_table_replay, xlevels, contrasts, estimation_converged, inference_ready), data_review, config, prep, and opt (optimizer_diagnostics, optimizer_polish, start_review, mml_initialization).
